lines.en: The ground shakes with every step.
This frame of mine makes doors feel narrow.
Out of my way — a bump finishes you.
Shoulders push the branches aside.
Arms that could move mountains hang at my sides.
My walk carries a wall of air.
A giant doesn't need to go around.
Grass flattens under my feet.
One of my steps is three of yours.
This body is tall and heavy.
Stones I step on crumble.
My shadow arrives before I do.
Standing arms crossed, I'm a wall.

lines.zh: 这身肌肉不听使唤地绷着。
lines.en: These muscles stay clenched.
My head nearly touches the branches.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸像一个大风箱。
lines.en: My breathing sounds like a great bellows.

lines.zh: 克隆的拳头比原来更硬。
lines.en: Cloned fists hit harder than his did.
I'm losing patience.

lines.zh: 小东西在脚边跑来跑去。
lines.en: Little things scurry around my feet.

lines.zh: 我一动，地上的灰就起来。
lines.en: I shift and dust rises.

lines.zh: 这具壳子没有旧日的狂笑。
lines.en: This shell lacks the old mad laughter.
Shoulder itches — I rub it on bark.
I don't need to think much.
Standing here is frightening enough.
I flex — knuckles crack.
Wind hits me and breaks apart.
Doesn't your neck ache, looking up like that?
Look up if you want my face.
That height gap should frighten you.

lines.zh: 你的拳头有我的指节大吗？
lines.en: Is your fist as big as my knuckle?
Two steps back, then we talk.
These hands could crush you.

lines.zh: 我看见你在算逃跑路线。
lines.en: I can see you planning a way out.
You don't have the strength for this.

lines.zh: 克隆出来的力气没减半分。
lines.en: Cloned, and not a bit weaker.
Don't laugh. I hate laughter.
You're scrawnier than the last bunch.
Stand still and save me the effort.
That thing in your hand is too small.

lines.zh: 说一句就够，我不听长篇。
lines.en: One sentence. I don't do speeches.
I'll count to three. Best be gone.
This body dislikes waiting.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，脖子都仰酸了。
lines.en: You look up at me until your neck aches.
That barely broke the skin.
I swayed. Only swayed.
You can actually hurt me? Impressive.
Pain arrives from the clone.
My shoulder's starting to sag.
This body feels pain — and anger.
A few more and I'll get serious.
Stand firm. Show no fear.
Only a big slab of meat interests me.
That wouldn't fill a tooth gap.
Roast the whole beast and I'll eat.
Take it away. I've no patience.

lines.zh: 我饿，但我不为小东西低头。
lines.en: I'm hungry, but I don't stoop for scraps.
That pot is one mouthful.
Leave the barrel. You go.
You hold that food with shaking hands.
A clone's stomach is empty too.
Drop it and run. Don't look back.
You hit me like hitting a tree.
I didn't move half a step.
Little thing, stop circling my feet.
I turn and you're thrown.
Steady — even my shadow weighs.
Don't push. It won't work.
Getting bumped by me is more than pain.

lines.zh: 你从下面穿过去，倒机灵。
lines.en: Slipping under me — clever.
Clear out, my turning circle's wide.
A thing like me has no use for that.
Clones don't have offspring.
This muscle was manufactured.
Don't speak of it in front of me.
This body of mine only breaks things.
No time and no interest.
Wrong creature, little one.
That weakness isn't mine.
Even my name is borrowed.
Shut your mouth and change the subject.
Something this small?
I can lift it with one hand.
A stone — good for throwing.
This log's too thin.
Pick it up and toss it away.
This meat is mine.

lines.zh: 别怕，我不抢你的小玩意。
lines.en: Relax, I won't take your trinket.
Hand me that club on the ground.
One squeeze and it flattens.
Halt. You've been spotted.
A target this size is easy to find.
You can't outrun my reach.
Don't hide behind a tree — it's too thin.
I'll smash what's in the way first.
You've got ki on you. I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我锁定了，别浪费我时间。
lines.en: Marked. Don't waste my time.
Look — my hand's coming up.

lines.zh: 这具身体的力气还没用完。
lines.en: This body's strength is far from spent.
One step, two, and I'm there.
Gripping that weapon won't help.
I've got my eye on you, little one.
Target's on the left. Don't mix it up.
I'll walk over slowly. Don't rush me.
That weapon looks awfully light.
I'll just walk straight at you.
That gap means nothing to me.
My swing is slow, but it lands heavy.
Circling my legs is irritating.
I hit the ground and you lose footing.

lines.zh: 你躲得很好，可惜手太短。
lines.en: Good dodging, but your reach is short.
This tree won't stop me.
I'll smash your way out.

lines.zh: 我把指节按得咔咔响，等不及了。
lines.en: I crack my knuckles; I have waited long enough.
Going to jump? Good.
Driving you to a wall suits me.
This punch needs room — I'll make it.
I've got you cornered in this clearing.
Take this massive fist!
The ground cracks where I strike.
My shoulder's quicker than my fist.
Little thing — fly out of here.
This one needs no aiming.
I hit beside your feet to make you jump.
Barrage — no breathing room.
My backhand is thicker than your shield.
And a kick to finish. Stay down.
Missed, and broke the tree instead.
This body doesn't know restraint.
Smashing your guard apart.
Slow and steady — one at a time.
The ground's shaking. See it?

lines.zh: 这一拳是从记忆里来的。
lines.en: This punch came from a memory.
This shell is bursting with strength.

lines.zh: 我一站直，头顶就是树冠。
lines.en: I stand and my head's at the canopy.
This cloned body is absurdly big.

lines.zh: 我从光里踏出来，地一沉。
lines.en: Out of the light — the ground sinks.
My shoulders break the air first.
This forest can't hold me.
I lift a foot and the stone crumbles.
Someone built me too big.

lines.zh: 我扫了一眼四周，都是小的。
lines.en: One glance — everything's small.
The master wants me standing here.
Waking up, this body wants to swing.
There's a smell of rust in the air.

lines.zh: 我捏了捏拳头，试试力气。
lines.en: A squeeze of the fist, testing strength.

lines.zh: 这高度，我很久没习惯了。
lines.en: I'm not used to this height.

lines.zh: 我压低肩膀，走进这片林子。
lines.en: Lowering my shoulders into the woods.
I straighten up — joints crack.
Feet planted. This ground is mine.

lines.zh: 火在皮肤上烧，焦味难闻。
lines.en: Fire on my skin — the stench of burning.

lines.zh: 我这体重摔下来，坑都砸出来了。
lines.en: Landing this weight dug a crater.

lines.zh: 水太浅，却糊住了我的脸。
lines.en: The water's shallow but it's smothering me.
The blast made me stagger.

lines.zh: 一根小刺扎进我的手臂。
lines.en: A splinter lodged in my arm.
Spellcraft crawls beneath my skin.
This body's ravenous.
Lightning makes my muscles jerk.

lines.zh: 再重的身体也拉不住我。
lines.en: Even this weight can't hold me here.
